impressions.text: The delivery aligned repository conventions and tooling with vecs; the worker reported passing local verification before review.
Review caught that the commit-message hook rejected merge commits and that typecheck detection covered fewer triggers than vecs; the worker added fixes and regression tests for both.
The initial stop followed a report of no CI checks; the orchestrator identified this as a CI registration race and asked the worker to wait and retry.
After the fixes, the worker reported passing local checks and both CI checks passing.
